Specification: A specification and formal proof of a sequence summation algorithm. It defines a recursive summation operator 'SeqSum', a state machine to compute the sum iteratively, and provides a complete hierarchical proof of correctness using TLAPS, including lemmas for induction on sequence length.
TheoremNames: Lemma1 == \A s \in Seq(Int) : SeqSum(s) = IF s = << >> THEN 0 ELSE s[1] + SeqSum(Tail(s))
FrontDef == \A S : \A s \in Seq(S) : Front(s) = [i \in 1..(Len(s)-1) |-> s[i]]
Lemma1_Proof == \A s \in Seq(Int) : SeqSum(s) = IF s = << >> THEN 0 ELSE s[1] + SeqSum(Tail(s))
Lemma2 == \A S : \A s \in Seq(S) : Len(s) > 0 => /\ Tail(s) \in Seq(S) /\ Front(s) \in Seq(S) /\ Len(Tail(s)) = Len(s) - 1 /\ Len(Front(s)) = Len(s) - 1
Lemma2a == ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), Len(s) > 1 PROVE Tail(s) = [i \in 1..(Len(s) - 1) |-> s[i+1]]
Lemma5_Proof == \A s \in Seq(Int) : (Len(s) > 0) => SeqSum(s) = SeqSum(Front(s)) + s[Len(s)]
